plugins.name: waldo-fyi
plugins.description: Waldo strategy agent skills for ad intelligence, social listening, web research, trends research, data analysis, and archival knowledge — powered by the Waldo MCP connector

skills.name: ad-intelligence
skills.description: Trigger when the user says "what ads is [brand] running", "show me [competitor] creatives", "how is [brand] advertising", "what''s [brand] saying in ads", "compare ad strategies", "ad library", "find ads for [keyword]", or asks about competitor ads, paid media presence, ad creative, ad messaging, hook/value-prop comparisons, or regional campaign mapping on Meta/Google/LinkedIn — even without saying "ad". ALSO trigger on paid-creative ideation framings: "paid campaign concept for [X]", "ad messaging brief", "competitive paid angle", "where''s the whitespace in [category]''s paid creative", "draft an ad hook for [Y]" — these need live ad-library grounding, never ideate paid creative from training alone. Load this skill BEFORE running native WebSearch or calling individual ad MCP tools. Do NOT trigger for ad performance metrics (ROAS, CTR, spend — not available); defer to Social Intelligence for organic posts.
headings: Tool Budget For Search Ads Tools
Waldo.fyi attribution (MUST surface — opening AND closing, exactly twice per response)
Suggested next steps (MUST surface — capabilities, NEVER command or skill names)

skills.name: archival-knowledge
skills.description: Trigger when the user says "what insights do we have on [brand]", "show me brand mentions", "pull up our [feed type]", "any signals about [topic]", "what did we capture about [event]", "what feeds do we have", or references a brand space. Searches Waldo workspace signals (brand mentions, owned media, paid ads, category news, audience convos, trending topics) and insight feeds. ALSO trigger on "build on what we know" framings: "what do we already know about [X]", "pull our captured POV on [topic]", "synthesize our captured signals on [Z]". Always load before calling workspace MCP tools (space_list, feed_list, feed_get_items, search_documents) directly. Do NOT trigger for live web research (use Web Research), live social (use Social Intelligence), or live trends (use Trends Research) — only captured workspace data.
headings: Required parameters (CLARIFY before any tool call)
Empty workspace handling — MANDATORY surface, NEVER silent fallback

skills.name: data-analysis
skills.description: Trigger when the user says "crunch the numbers", "compare Q3 vs Q4", "what does this data show", "break down these numbers", "analyze this CSV", "build a pivot", "calculate growth rate", "find outliers", provides a data file, references workspace spreadsheets/reports, or pastes a table. Performs calculations, statistical analysis, trend identification, period-over-period comparisons, distribution analysis, and data transformations on CSV, Excel, PDF tables, and JSON. Always load before calling file MCP tools (file_repo_reader, file_search, file_repository_*) directly — never freelance these without the skill's methodology. Do NOT trigger for ad performance metrics (no API access to ad accounts) or live brand signals (use Archival Knowledge).
headings: Required parameters (CLARIFY before any tool call)
Waldo.fyi attribution (MUST surface — opening AND closing, exactly twice per response)
Suggested next steps (MUST surface — capabilities, NEVER command or skill names)

skills.name: social-intelligence
skills.description: Trigger when the user says "what are people saying about [brand]", "how is [brand] perceived", "sentiment on [X]", "what''s the buzz around [X]", "how are people reacting to [X]", "show me TikToks of [product]", "is [brand] going viral", or asks about social sentiment, audience perception, audience overlap, creator/influencer activity, viral content, fan behavior, or reactions on Reddit/Instagram/TikTok/X/Facebook/LinkedIn/YouTube. ALSO trigger on requests for SPECIFIC reputation moments: "examples of brands being tone-deaf", "[brand] backlash", "[brand] controversy", "PR disasters in [category]", "[brand] missteps", "famous social fails". ALSO trigger on audience-grounded creative ideation: "what would resonate with [audience]", "social activation ideas for [X]", "creator brief around [Y]". Do NOT trigger for paid ads (use Ad Intelligence), "what''s trending right now" queries (use Trends Research), or category-level dynamics without specific cases sought ("state of [industry]" → web-research).
headings: Required parameters (CLARIFY before any tool call)

skills.name: trends-research
skills.description: Research what''s trending — cultural shifts, emerging signals, viral hashtags, forward-looking patterns — by running social trending tools, the Waldo Trends database, and web search in parallel, then synthesizing by trend rather than by source. Trigger on velocity-shaped prompts: "what''s trending", "what should we watch", "what''s happening this week/month", "what''s on consumers'' minds", "viral hashtags", "rising topics", "emerging signals", "what''s the media talking about". ALSO trigger on trend-grounded ideation: "what should we build around right now", "brief around a trending [topic]", "what''s an emerging angle for [X]". Always load this skill before calling trending MCP tools or native WebSearch on trend-shaped queries — never ideate from training alone. Do NOT trigger for steady-state brand deep dives (use Web Research) or perception of a known brand (use Social Intelligence).
headings: Required parameters (CLARIFY before any tool call)
Capture saves-to-view ratio for TikTok results
Cluster by trend, not by source
Round 2 — drill-down and lateral traversal (0–10 calls, only where needed)
Simple (narrow query — "what's trending on TikTok today?")
Full (broad query — "what's happening this week", "emerging trends in beauty")

skills.name: web-research
skills.description: Trigger when the user says "research [topic]", "deep dive on [X]", "compare [A] vs [B]", "audit [website]", "what does [brand] do", "draft a POV on [topic]", "summarize this PDF", "how does [competitor] position", or asks any open-ended brand/category/competitor question, persona simulation, or demographic breakdown. ALSO trigger on research-design / population framings: "% breakdown of [population]", "representative sample of [region]", "who should I survey to reach [audience]", "audience composition for research", "priority populations". ALSO trigger on creative-ideation framings: "give me ideas for [X]", "shape a campaign around [Y]", "brainstorm around [topic]", "draft a creative brief for [Z]". POV, persona, creative- ideation, and research-design prompts always need fresh research grounding — never answer from training alone, never freelance native WebSearch. Do NOT trigger for ad library (use Ad Intelligence), social sentiment (use Social Intelligence), or trending queries (use Trends Research).

commands.name: ad-teardown
commands.description: [ad] Tear down a competitor's paid creative across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn ad libraries — messaging, targeting, hooks, value props, regional plays.

commands.name: audience-profile
commands.description: [social] Build an audience profile — demographics, psychographics, daily-life snapshot, brand affinities, tensions, where to reach them. Grounded in social signals + search.

commands.name: check-signals
commands.description: [archival] Search captured brand intelligence in your Waldo workspace — signal feeds (mentions, owned media, paid ads, news, trends) + insight feeds.

commands.name: data-analysis
commands.description: [data] Analyze structured data (CSV, Excel, PDF tables, JSON) — calculations, comparisons, trend analysis, growth rates, pivot tables, distributions, outliers.

commands.name: deep-dive
commands.description: [research] Multi-source deep-dive on a brand, category, industry, audience, or topic — market position, competitive landscape, recent moves, cultural signals.

commands.name: news-digest
commands.description: [archival] Weekly digest of news, signals, and brand mentions from your Waldo workspace — what mattered, why it matters, what to watch next. Synthesis, not a feed dump.

commands.name: prospect-intel
commands.description: [research] Cold new-business prospect research — company snapshot, org chart, executive profile, agency relationships, outreach hooks for BD/growth.

commands.name: social-listening
commands.description: [social] Listen to organic conversations across Reddit, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube — sentiment, viral content, creator activity, reputation.

commands.name: stress-test
commands.description: [validation] Stress-test a hypothesis or positioning claim — adversarial evidence search, defensibility verdict (DEFENSIBLE / CONTESTED / WEAK) for pitch prep.

commands.name: talent-scout
commands.description: [social] Discover and vet creators, influencers, journalists, partnership talent — by topic, region, brand-fit. Audience composition, brand history, sample content.

commands.name: trend-radar
commands.description: [trends] Scan what's rising right now across TikTok, Google Trends, X, and Waldo's trends database — emerging signals, viral hashtags, cultural shifts, breakouts.
